target.description: Target java object or c3 type instance.

caches.description: If `true` will profile memory used by C3 caches.

nonCacheStatics.description: If `true` will profile memory used by Java static variables that are not C3 caches.

group.description: If set then will collect instances of C3 Type or Java classes accordingly.

unit.description: If set then will collect instances of C3 Type or Java classes accordingly.

flat.description:
If `true` then JvmMemProfile#objs will contain a flat list of all objects and JvmObjMemUsage#children will be
empty.

depth.description: Maximum depth for children in JvmObjMemUsage.

limit.description: Maximum number of elements in JvmMemProfile#objs and in JvmObjMemUsage#children.

minUsage.description: Minimum memory usage for elements in JvmMemProfile#objs and in JvmObjMemUsage#children.

gc.description: If `true` will hint JVM to run garbage collection.

forceGc.description:
If `true` will attempt to allocate large enough memory in hopes that JVM will be forced to run full garbage
collection. WARNING! may cause JVM or Thread death!

includeJavaPackageName.description: If `true` keys will include java package name.

doNotCollapseKnownCollections.description:
If `true` will not collapse known collections like `LinkedHashMap` but instead will profile every private field
like `head`, `tail` and `table`.

doNotIgnoreNonStrongReferences.description: If `true` will not ignore `week`, `soft`, `phantom`, etc references.

doNotIgnoreJmx.description: If `true` then com.sun.jmx.mbeanserver.JmxMBeanServer will be included in the total memory.

strategy.description:
Optional override for memory instrumentation strategy; if missing then will use one of these as available
otherwise:
 - AGENT - use java allocation instrumentation agent or fail if not present
 - UNSAFE - use sun.misc.Unsafe or fail if not available
 - SPEC - use predefined sizes for various java classes
